steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Where should we go today? We've been banned from swimming in the hot springs... how about we get a few more guys and play hide-and-seek in that plate?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Enis said we shouldn't go to the shore. I want to go to the volcano museum again. We couldn't find Dad the last time.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: No point, you won't find him... hey, where's Enis working today?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: It's Wednesday. He should be at Mr. Tom's shop in the afternoon.

steps.name: Boy & Girl
steps.text: The drinks shop!

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Chocolate.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Strawberry.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Alright, alright.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Hey, is that a new flavor? What does cake-flavored ice cream taste like? Can we have one?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Tom says only one scoop per kid per day.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: But you don't eat ice cream. Can we have yours?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Don't be like that... Enis is always working hard...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I'm not a kid anymore.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: But it's so hot today. There's less than one scoop left by the time the ice cream reaches your mouth. It's not fair.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Yeah, what should we do?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: It's so hot today. Cake-flavored ice cream sounds great, doesn't it?

steps.name: Boy & Girl
steps.text: (Expectant look)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Alright, you can have one more scoop... but only if you promise to be back home by dinner, and help Harley set the table.

steps.name: Boy & Girl
steps.text: Okay—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: You say that every time. Let's hope you still have appetite by dinner.
An ice cream cone floats by the little girl. She stares in amazement as a piece of ice cream melts in the midday sun.
The strawberry-flavored ice cream drops, forming a puddle on the ground. The invisible creature steps on it, leaving behind its footprints.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: I think an ice cream just ran away.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Ice cream? Ran away?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: I think it was strawberry too.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Does that mean we get another scoop if we catch it?

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: One ice cream, please.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Three gold certificates.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: No freebies?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: We're a business here, ma'am, not a charity.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: Coffee flavor, then.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Thank you for your business.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Surprised to see foreign visitors at a time like this.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: Maybe you underestimate the charm of this place.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: Why aren't you enjoying the summer? Back home, kids your age are hanging out on the streets, having fun.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: It's hard to be the big brother, I guess?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Got to make a living.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: Do you know any instruments?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Instruments? I didn't even take singing lessons...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Does a kalimba count?

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: I think you'd go well with a saxophone.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Doesn't sound like I could afford it.

steps.name: Byrd
steps.text: I'm in a good mood because I found a new job. Will you have a chat with me if I buy you a drink?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Sorry, but I have to get to my next job.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Come to my family's shop if you want to chat.

steps.name: Fragrance Shop Owner
steps.text: You mean the logistics hub will help me sell my wares to other countries?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Not only that, buying will be easier as well. You'll be able to procure fresh ingredients straight from the producers, for example.

steps.name: Fragrance Shop Owner
steps.text: Hm... that doesn't sound too bad.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Will you accept relocation, then? And can MountainDash Logistics expect your vote in the upcoming public opinion survey?

steps.name: Fragrance Shop Owner
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Fragrance Shop Owner
steps.text: I was planning to move to the city center anyway. Being able to buy Victorian clothes more easily sounds appealing.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Thank you for your support! I won't take up any more of your time.

steps.name: Fragrance Shop Owner
steps.text: No rush. Don't you want to learn more about my fragrances?

steps.name: Fragrance Shop Owner
steps.text: I know just the right ones for a cute boy like you.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: O-Okay...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hey, kid.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Emperor! Are you here on vacation too?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Vacation's a state of mind, and I'm on vacation every day. Who'd stay in an ordinary place in a summer like this, though?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Naw, that's all secondary. I'm here to take back what's mine!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Those dumbass sheep stole my favorite album! The one that won me the gold, first time I hit the Obsidian Festival! Serial number 000001!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Sure, Dolly's in a real small club of entities I can actually talk music with, but I gotta give him a piece of my mind for lettin' his clones run wild in this world!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: He really think his kids can hit the soul the way my music can?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Er... excuse me? Who's Dolly?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Man, forget it. I'm talkin' a conflict beyond mortal comprehension here. Anyway, what's got you hangin' around these parts?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: And what's that smell on you? Like you rolled yourself in a Sargonian rainforest mud puddle three times, then fell into the champagne tower at a cocktail party.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...That bad?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: MountainDash Logistics wants the rebuilding project for this commercial district, but we have competition.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aw, you playin' a game of turf war here.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Where's Eurill? He just dump all his work on you and run off on vacation?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I wouldn't put it that way...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Mmhm. Anyway, good luck, kid. Maybe swipe the stock he holdin' when his back's turned. Give him a little summer surprise.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Then maybe we'll have somethin' to talk about next time I see him at a party.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Oh, hold the conversation. Think I saw—two sheep! Hey, gimme back my album!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sheep?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: (Is the Little Black Sheep still here?)

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: (It's slow, it couldn't have gone far...)

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Huh? The old sign over there, too...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: You ate the address on the envelope, didn't you?
The furry creature wanders down the street, eating street sign after street sign.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Little Black Sheep... wait!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Did you eat the envelope from that letter to the museum?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Little Black Sheep!
Passersby turn around to look at the girl, who is crying out frantically while chasing empty air.
She hardly has time to care for appearances as she huffs and pants, almost tripping over herself.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Little Black Sheep! Wait!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Finally done with this batch... really got to be more careful about asking someone to take my shift. I paid him good money only for him to make so many mistakes... what's the next place?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Hey, where did the address on the envelope go? Did someone tear it off?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: What happened to the addresses? I go out for a minute, and now they're all gone?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Good thing I have the records on the terminal... but seriously, what a bother?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Me and my rotten luck...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Well, I guess there's nothing to do but check one by one... the next shift is almost here. Better hurry...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Run, Enis, run... run and make your dough...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Take care of your siblings...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Look out! I can't stop with so much stuff on me!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Ugh—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Ugh... my leg...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Hey, you okay?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Are you alright? Wake up!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: D-Doctor...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Is there a doctor around here?

steps.name: Serious Voice
steps.text: When are you going to get proper treatment, Enis?

steps.name: Hushed Voice
steps.text: I... I'll go with you to Rhodes Island once I'm done with this... my family can't do without...

steps.name: Serious Voice
steps.text: A doctor shouldn't be hiding the identity of a patient. I understand your difficulties, but being responsible to your family means being responsible to your own health.

steps.name: Hushed Voice
steps.text: I-I know what to do...

steps.name: Hushed Voice
steps.text: Dr. Ceylon... all Oripathy patients eventually die, don't they?

steps.name: Serious Voice
steps.text: All of us eventually die, Oripathy or not. The end is simply clearer for people with Oripathy.

steps.name: Hushed Voice
steps.text: What eventually happens to people with Oripathy?

steps.name: Serious Voice
steps.text: The symptoms exhibited by late-stage Oripathy patients may differ depending on the location of the condition.

steps.name: Serious Voice
steps.text: For example, Oripathy has damaged the hearing of the girl that you brought. She is almost completely deaf without a hearing aid.

steps.name: Serious Voice
steps.text: I hate to say it, but your Originium crystal formation is near your heart, and it can be life-threatening if not managed properly.

steps.name: Hushed Voice
steps.text: Well, at least that means I'll have all my faculties until I die.

steps.name: Serious Voice
steps.text: Say that again, and I'll deliver you to Rhodes Island by force right now.

steps.name: Hushed Voice
steps.text: Just kidding... thanks, Dr. Ceylon.

steps.name: Hushed Voice
steps.text: Here's the money for both of us... I'll be going.

steps.name: Hushed Voice
steps.text: Bye.
The sun casts its rays on the bed. Adele slowly opens her eyes to the sound of muffled conversation.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You're awake. How are you feeling?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You were knocked out after bumping into someone on the street. The young man brought you here and left behind all the money he had. Said it was for your medical bills.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You must be careful, Eyjafjalla.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: The reason you passed out was low blood sugar, but I gave you a physical anyway, and I'm sure you can read the data about your Oripathy yourself...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Thank you, Dr. Ceylon. I'm feeling fine now. Can I go?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You're staying here for the rest of the afternoon. No going anywhere.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I have a few patients to visit. You stay put. Rhodes Island will hear if you're not here when I get back.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Guess I lost it...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What was the Little Black Sheep trying to tell me?
Adele sits up on the bed. The photo falls out of her pocket.
'How have you been? I'm doing fine here.'
'It's been a long time. I miss you.'

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I'm fine...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: How are you?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Vati, Mutti, in a few years, I'll be the same age you were when I was born.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What was life like for you, at the time?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Thank you so much for...
Drip, drop.
Tears fall on the paper.
Adele stops writing and crosses out what she had written down.

steps.name: Impatient Voice
steps.text: Shift's about to start. Where are you? There's a lot of stuff to move.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Almost there, almost there!

steps.name: Polite Voice
steps.text: Mr. Enis, the hot springs hotel shop that you asked about is now available for purchase.

steps.name: Polite Voice
steps.text: You will need to pay a deposit before the end of the month if you're still interested...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Before the end of the month? Alright, I'll get back to you...

steps.name: Worried Voice
steps.text: Enis, are your brother and sister with you?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Brother and sister?

steps.name: Worried Voice
steps.text: It's almost dinner time, and they're not back yet. Tell them to come back soon.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I, I... alright!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Dagnabbit!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: This, stupid, car—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Frickin hell! Consarnit!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Er... are you okay?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: *Pant*—*pant*—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Talking a walk.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I followed the tourist guide's recommended route, but the shops listed aren't any different from those in Lungmen, so I was about to go back.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Were you picking a fight with this pickup truck?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: The engine's old. Igniter doesn't work well.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Let me take a look.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Someone's blocked the vent with a ball of paper. Who could have done it? Let's see... a flyer?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Must be some kid's practical joke...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Well, I've got to be on my way. Thanks!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: One moment.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: The mark on that box on the passenger seat, and on the flyer. It's Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals, isn't it?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Er...
